Battles 1.8.1 Battle Basics 1.8.2 Battle Result 1.9 Toshi Ranbo 1.10 End of Turn 1.11 The Big Picture Gunsen: How to Play Goal Be the first player to earn 7 Achievements . The moment you get your 7th Achievement, you win. Achievements come from: Winning a battle as the attacker (twice possible) Gaining control of Toshi Ranbo Maintaining control of Toshi Ranbo Completing up to 2 different Clan Goals Controlling 2 Shrines at the same time Building both of your Buildings Using all 3 Noble Actions Having 3 Village Tokens Buying 3 Tactics Achievements are generally permanent once earned. The exception is the Toshi Ranbo Maintain Control Achievement, which is lost if you no longer have troops there. Your Turn Every turn follows these steps: Choose an Order Card Place the Order Card Activate a Column OR take a Noble Action Resolve Battle if one was triggered End your turn 1. Choose an Order Card Choose 1 face-up Order Card from the Order Card row. Pay its resource cost, if any. The card shows which resources/actions it will provide when activated. 2. Place the Order Card You have two choices: Activate a Column - Place the Order Card face-up at the top of the matching colored column on your Clan Board. Take a Noble Action - Place the Order Card face-down on an available Noble Action spot and pay its Influence cost. 3A. Activate a Column If you placed your Order Card in a column, activate that column from top to bottom . This means you activate: - The Order Card you just placed - Older Order Cards already in that column - The printed actions on your Clan Board You may ignore individual effects if you don't want to use them. Your columns generally let you: - Recruit — Add troops to your Fort or buildings you control. - Gain Influence — Gain Influence and movement. - Armory — Gain Koku and movement, plus improve your battle abilities. - Expand — Gain Wood, movement, build Buildings, and buy Tactics. Important: Order Cards remain in their columns for the rest of the game. Every time you activate that column, you activate those cards again. Movement Each movement lets you move an army to an adjacent territory. - An army is one or more of your troops in a territory. - Normally, you can have a maximum of 5 troops in one territory. - You can split or combine armies. - You can buy additional movement using the resource shown by the active column. - You may use the same army multiple times during your turn. Moving into an opponent's territory triggers a Battle and ends all remaining movement for the turn. Buildings When activating Expand, you may build your Clan Buildings if you can pay their costs. You can build in: - A territory containing your army - A territory adjacent to your army - A territory adjacent to your Fort The territory cannot contain enemy troops, a token, or another tile. Building both of your Buildings earns an Achievement. Tactics When activating Expand, you may buy Tactics by paying their costs. You can have a maximum of 3 Tactics . Buying your third Tactic earns an Achievement. 3B. Noble Actions Instead of activating a column, you can spend Influence to perform an available Noble Action. The three Noble Actions are: 1 Influence: Take another Order Card, place it in any column, and activate that column. 2 Influence: Recruit one of your Clan Heroes, then activate any column. 3 Influence: Gain one of your Clan's Special Orders and activate its column.
